name: Stubble
author: Erin Carter
description: A harvested field at night seen from straight above: parallel windrows of stubble cross the frame on a shallow diagonal while an unseen burn line advances across them. The glow is gated hard by the fuel, so the fire reads as a chain of discrete point-fires catching one row after another — each igniting with a prominent flare, then guttering into a graded ember bead with row-aligned cooling sparks. Staggered burn fields crossfade unseen, so the relay never pauses or retreats.

params.label: Line speed
params.effect: How fast the fire line advances across the rows.

params.label: Row spacing
params.effect: Distance in CSS pixels between windrows; wider spacing leaves longer dark gaps between point-fires.

params.label: Flare intensity
params.effect: Strength of the prominent catch-flare when the front ignites a fresh row; zero removes the flares.

params.label: Spark density
params.effect: How many cooling sparks lie along the charred rows behind the line.
